Tamil Nadu to hold by-elections in 7 constituencies

The Karur Assembly seat in Tamil Nadu has been declared vacant, necessitating a by-election. This vacancy contributes to a total of seven constituencies in the state that will undergo by-elections. The development sets the stage for electoral contests across these seven seats.
